findings.title: Untrusted search term is concatenated into SQL, enabling injection
findings.evidence: The query now embeds the caller-provided term directly into the SQL text and executes it without parameters, so a term containing a quote can break out of the LIKE pattern and alter the statement.
findings.evidence_quote: q = "SELECT * FROM docs WHERE title LIKE '%" + term + "%'"
findings.recommendation: Restore parameterized execution, e.g. keep the SQL as 'SELECT * FROM docs WHERE title LIKE ?' and pass the pattern as a bound parameter such as '(f'%{term}%',)'.
